title: 🪪️ Repo Identity Vocabulary And Test Projections
description: 🪪️ The entity-emoji vocabulary implementations load and the actual grapheme and codec projections produced by test adapters.

EntityEmojiTable.description: 🔣️ The single source of truth `🧬️schema/🔣️entity-emojis.json` holds. Go reads it through a module-relative path at first use; Rust embeds it with `include_str!`. Every emoji is stored WITHOUT the U+FE0F presentation selector.

textDefaultEmojis.description: 📝️ Code points whose Unicode default presentation is text, and which therefore get U+FE0F re-added.

collections.description: 🗃️ One emoji per collection kind; an empty string means the collection is unlabelled.

allEntityOrder.description: 📜️ The order the deduplicated vocabulary is reported in.

graphemes.description: 🧲️ `<vector name>=<leading emoji>|<remaining text>`; the emoji half is empty when the string does not start with one.

normalizations.description: 😀️ `<input code points>=<normalised code points>`, both as `U+XXXX` sequences so the projection is readable and selector-exact.

identifiers.description: 🆔️ `<seed>=<identifier>`; identical for the same seed in every implementation.

vocabulary.description: 🔣️ The deduplicated entity emoji vocabulary, as `U+XXXX` sequences.
